source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Log into the BMC WebUI and navigate to SMTP setting page.
2. Under SMTP server options, enter in the IP address of your SMTP server. (If your SMTP server requires authentication, check the box next to requires authentication, and enter in the username and password.)
3. Select the authentication method.
4. Ensure you can connect to the SMTP server.
5. Configure the server for email alerts and cause an alert (power off/power on should be easy to cause).

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. SMTP server should receive the same event information from BMC.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" lan print 1 2>&1 | grep -iE "SMTP|IP Address"; echo ---sel-last---; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sel list last 3 2>&1; echo ---mail---; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sel get 0x0010 2>&1 | head -5
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return BMC `lan print` SMTP/IP lines plus the latest SEL entries, so the user can confirm the SMTP server config and see whether a generated event gets delivered to the SMTP server (operator checks the mail server inbox).
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: requires an SMTP server IP/credential to be configured and a reachable mail server to receive the event; event-delivery verification is confirmed at the mail server, operator-side.

original_test_intent: Configure BMC SMTP notification, generate one approved event and prove the controlled mailbox receives a uniquely correlated message with matching event content.
original_method: An engineer configures the WebUI; automation can generate the approved event, collect BMC/SEL/mail evidence and compare fields.
manual_activity: Engineer approves/configures the WebUI and controlled mailbox; after setup, event generation and delivery correlation can be automated.
required_inputs: Safe event and unique correlation token/timestamp
Delivery timeout, retry policy and cleanup
safety_requirements: Never use production recipients or expose SMTP/BMC secrets.
Use one safe approved event; do not create uncontrolled power cycles or mail storms.
Restore settings and preserve original failure/mail evidence.
agent_execution_scope: After setup, trigger the approved event, collect SEL and server/mailbox message, compare fields and package evidence.
engineer_actions: Approve/configure SMTP and event plan; confirm mailbox authority.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: SEL read-back is useful but cannot prove SMTP delivery; plaintext credentials and fixed SEL ID are rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a controlled SMTP sink/API and unique event correlation with secret-safe access.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: WebUI SMTP settings, authentication, one alert, content match and 10/10 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Snapshot config, set controlled TLS SMTP, generate one approved uniquely identifiable event, capture server receipt, compare BMC/SEL/mail fields and restore.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BMC SMTP implementation and lab mail service.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform SMTP alert and mail-server security documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds secure server-side receipt and deterministic correlation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Proves delivery rather than only BMC configuration.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Misconfiguration can leak alerts or credentials.

project_override_considerations: Project may select a non-power event if it exercises the same notification path; record actual event and coverage.
expected_evidence: Raw received message/server log with correlation

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Source consistently targets SMTP alert delivery; the power event is an example, not a contradictory mandate.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Server, mailbox and event are inputs. Manual configuration followed by automatable delivery/correlation is PARTIAL.

review_improvement: Requires server-side receipt and exact event correlation, preventing configuration-only false success.
independent_technical_reasoning: Once a controlled mailbox and approved event exist, the notification path and content comparison are machine-verifiable; WebUI setup remains engineer-owned preparation.
